about.title: About me
about.subtitle: This is who I am.
about.description:
Hello, I am Abraham Jiménez Cabrejas, a Full Stack web developer with experience also in creating desktop applications and industrial automation solutions. Since I was very young, I knew that my path would be linked to technology, at just 6 years old I had my first computer, and since then I have never stopped exploring, learning, and building.

I am passionate about programming, electronics, system administration, and everything related to technological innovation. I enjoy facing new challenges, researching tools, optimizing processes, and creating systems that truly provide value. For me, technology is not just a profession, it is an art that allows me to transform ideas into something tangible.

I firmly believe in continuous learning and curiosity as the driving force of growth. Each project I participate in is an opportunity to improve, discover something new, and to keep moving forward.

Thank you for visiting my portfolio. I hope you enjoy my work and that you like the experience of exploring my projects. See you soon!
